query: UPDATE jobs SET state='cancelled',payload=CASE WHEN kind='webhook' THEN (payload-'token') #- '{event,data}' #- '{event,truncated}' ELSE payload-'token' END,claim_token=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,finished_at=clock_timestamp(),updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=$1 AND ((state='pending' AND $2::uuid IS NULL) OR (state='running' AND claim_token=$2))
